desc: Prove the structural characterization and bounded-diameter property of disjoint-interval graphs.
Derive formulas for minimum weighted paths of each possible length and handle disconnected pairs.
Design efficient range-minimum/preprocessing structures for all orientation and endpoint-order cases.
Prove correctness of the weighted shortest-path reduction and query procedure.
Analyze time and memory complexity under \(N,Q\le2\times10^5\).
Produce a complete Python implementation with fast input/output and validate both samples and edge cases.
